intro: Andorra is a landlocked country high in the Pyrenees between France and Spain.

chapters.title: Mountains
text: Andorra is made up of steep mountains and valleys; Coma Pedrosa is the highest peak. Its capital, Andorra la Vella, is the highest capital city in Europe, at more than 1,000 m.

chapters.title: Getting there
text: Andorra has no airport and no railway, so visitors arrive by road.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Andorra's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.

items.name: Grandvalira
items.text: The biggest ski area in the Pyrenees.
